scripts.lint: npm run lint:i18n && web-ext lint --source-dir=. --ignore-files scripts
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir=. --overwrite-dest --ignore-files amo-metadata.json scripts workstate.md AGENTS.md README.md CHANGELOG.md docs jsconfig.json package.json package-lock.json
scripts.sign:unlisted: web-ext sign --source-dir=. --channel=unlisted --ignore-files amo-metadata.json scripts workstate.md AGENTS.md README.md CHANGELOG.md docs jsconfig.json package.json package-lock.json
scripts.sign:listed: web-ext sign --source-dir=. --channel=listed --amo-metadata=amo-metadata.json --ignore-files amo-metadata.json scripts workstate.md AGENTS.md README.md CHANGELOG.md docs jsconfig.json package.json package-lock.json
scripts.lint:i18n: node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node scripts/test-i18n.mjs && npm run test:backup-label
